Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

Representing the pinnacle of Crewe-era craftsmanship, this top-of-the-range long-wheelbase model is one of only 127 examples ever produced, showing fewer than 25,000 miles from new.



Finished in Black over an elegant Cream leather interior, the Park Ward blends traditional Rolls-Royce luxury with advanced BMW-sourced engineering, delivering a refined grand touring experience equally suited for owner-driving or chauffeured travel.



Performance & Mechanical Specifications



  • 5.4L (5,379cc) SOHC V12 engine

  • 361 lb-ft of torque at 3,900 rpm

description:
Theres a razor-edged kind of drama to the 2018 BMW M3 CS the sort that doesnt simply enter a scene so much as sharpen it. It looks like a performance car that has been edited down to its most compelling essentials: leaner, tighter, and more focused than the already serious M3, with a stance that feels coiled rather than merely parked. Every line seems to serve a purpose. The front end has that familiar BMW intensity, but here it reads with a more urgent expression, like the car is already thinking two corners ahead. Carbon accents and subtle visual cues hint that this is not a costume of speed, but a true commitment to it.

The M3 CS carries itself with a kind of muscular restraint. It doesnt need to shout because its proportions do the talking: wide shoulders, a compact rear, and a profile that suggests kinetic tension even at rest. Its the automotive equivalent of an athlete in a tailored jacket disciplined, capable, and just a little dangerous. The details matter here: lightweight components, aggressive wheels, and the lowered visual mass all reinforce the idea that everything unnecessary has been stripped away in favor of response and precision.

Inside, the cabin feels like a focused command center that hasnt forgotten its still a BMW. The atmosphere is driver-first, with supportive seating, purposeful controls, and a layout that puts intent ahead of ornament. Theres still a premium polish to the materials, but the M3 CS is clearly more interested in grip, feedback, and concentration than lounge-like softness. Its a place built for commitment for tracking apexes, reading road texture, and staying fully engaged from start to finish. The cabin gives you what you need and quietly leaves out what you dont.

On the road, the M3 CS is all nerve and precision. The throttle feels immediate, the chassis alive with information, and the steering tuned to make every input feel meaningful. Its the kind of car that makes a straight road feel like a prelude and a sweeping bend feel like the main event. Acceleration arrives with the sort of force that compresses time, while the exhaust adds a hard-edged soundtrack that reminds you this machine is not here to be subtle. Yet for all that intensity, theres a polish to the way it goes about its business a sense that the performance is disciplined rather than chaotic. Its fast, yes, but more importantly it feels purposeful.

What makes the M3 CS compelling is that it balances seriousness with just enough joy to keep the experience intoxicating. Its a car for drivers who want sharpness without sterility, aggression without excess, and speed that feels earned every second youre behind the wheel. In short, the 2018 BMW M3 CS is a precision instrument with a pulse taut, focused, and thrillingly uncompromising.

This is not an aftermarket tune, it is a dealer-installed, documented performance package that includes:Stage 5 Dinan engine management softwareCold-air intakes with performance mass air flow metersIndividual performance throttle bodies with velocity stacksExhaust headers and full stainless-steel exhaust systemRevised front and rear suspension with strut tower braces (front and rear)3.45:1 Dinan limited-slip differential18? forged Dinan Performance wheelsThe result is a meaningfully stronger and sharper S62 V8 — already one of the greatest naturally aspirated engines ever fitted to a road car — with individual throttle bodies and double-VANOS working in concert with Dinan's calibration.Drivetrain & MechanicalPower is routed through a Getrag six-speed manual transmission — the correct and only acceptable gearbox for this car. A comprehensive mechanical refresh was completed in 2019, including:Clutch replacementRear main sealDriveshaft flex discTransmission mountsDifferential output shaft sealsValve cover gasketsSerpentine and accessory drive beltsAdditional work in 2024 addressed the oil pan gasket and a power steering hose. The BeastPower rear anti-sway bar brackets have been installed, and the car rides on 275/35 Michelin Pilot Sport 4S tires.ExteriorImola Red with Shadowline trim is among the most sought-after color combinations on the E39 platform. The car features xenon headlights with washers, fog lights, a glass sunroof, a trunk lid spoiler, and quad exhaust outlets. Paint correction and touch-up work was performed by Enthusiast Auto Group (EAG) of Cincinnati, Ohio, in 2013, addressing road rash on the hood, front bumper, and front fenders. Close-up photos of current paint condition are available — the car presents well but is honestly represented.InteriorThe cabin is trimmed in black with aluminum-look accents throughout. Replacement power-adjustable heated front sport seats in Black Nappa Point leather were installed in 2013. Additional features include:GROM Audio infotainment system with Apple CarPlay and Android AutoShort-throw shifter with weighted ZHP shift knobDual-zone automatic climate controlDinan-embroidered floor matsRear window sunshadesLo-Jack anti-theft systemPassport SRX radar detector and laser jammerM-branded 185-mph speedometer with variable-redline tachometerNote: the steering wheel is a replacement unit, there are wrinkles on the left-front door panel trim.DocumentationThis car comes with owner's manuals, BMW literature, Dinan literature, two keys, and continuous service records since 2003. The Carfax report shows no accidents or reported damage. Title is clean.The Bottom LineThe E39 M5 is widely regarded as one of the last truly analog driver's BMWs — high-revving, naturally aspirated, six-speed manual, no electrified assistance. This example takes that formula further with a factory-authorized Dinan S2 build documented from day one, a thorough mechanical history, and one of the best color combinations available. Cars like this, with this level of provenance, are becoming genuinely difficult to find. Visit Luxury Motorcars online at www.luxmotorcars.com to see more pictures of this vehicle. Theres a crisp, self-assured energy to the 2024 BMW 3 Series M340i the kind of sedan that looks like it keeps a neatly folded agenda and still finds time to be fast. It doesnt rely on drama to make an impression. Instead, it carries itself with that distinctly BMW sense of purpose: low, athletic, and tightly composed, with proportions that feel engineered rather than merely styled. The stance is planted, the surface work is clean, and the whole car gives off the impression that its always a half-step ahead of the moment.

From the outside, the M340i reads like precision in motion. The front end has a sharp, focused expression, with a grille and lighting signature that suggest alertness rather than aggression. The hood and body lines flow with controlled tension, shaping the car into something that looks ready to change lanes, carve corners, or simply glide past a long line of lesser commutes. Its sleek in a way that feels intelligent less about flash, more about getting the proportions exactly right. Even at rest, it looks like its maintaining momentum.

Open the door and the cabin continues the theme of disciplined performance. The interior feels driver-centric without becoming austere, wrapping the cockpit around you with a sense of intent. Materials feel premium and tactile, with a mix of soft-touch surfaces, crisp trim, and the kind of seating that encourages you to settle in and stay a while. Everything is positioned with logic and confidence, from the controls to the screens to the wheel in your hands. Its a space that feels modern, but not sterile like a high-end workspace that happens to be capable of very fast travel.

On the road, the M340i has the kind of personality that earns respect quickly. Its smooth when you want calm, sharp when you ask for more, and always seems to have a reserve of urgency waiting just beneath the surface. Acceleration feels eager and effortless, the chassis feels balanced and responsive, and the steering delivers the sort of feedback that makes even a simple on-ramp feel a little more meaningful. Its a car that invites engagement without demanding it, which is part of its charm: it can be civilized on Monday and seriously entertaining on Saturday.

Theres also a satisfying completeness to the whole package. The 3 Series shape still makes practical sense, but the M340i layers in enough performance edge to make every ordinary errand feel slightly upgraded. Its the rare sport sedan that can handle commuting, long drives, and spirited bursts with equal fluency. It doesnt need to be loud to be exciting it just needs an open road and a driver who notices the difference.

In short, the 2024 BMW 3 Series M340i is athletic refinement with a pulse: polished, responsive, and quietly intoxicating. Its for drivers who want their car to feel sharp, capable, and a little bit special every single time they turn the key.

description: Slip into this Gray 2023 BMW 3-Series sedan and you’ll remember why the 3 Series has been the benchmark for drivers who still love driving. Under the hood sits a 3.0L L6 DOHC 24V that brings smooth, confident power, while the RWD setup keeps the experience classic BMW—balanced, responsive, and ready to turn everyday errands into something you actually look forward to.This 3-Series feels as smart as it is sporty. With keyless entry and remote ignition, it’s easy to get going—especially when the weather doesn’t feel like cooperating. Inside, you’re greeted by a cabin that blends comfort and control: leather seating surfaces, supportive multi-adjustable power seats for both driver and passenger, and front heated seats for those early-morning commutes. The leather steering wheel is heated too, and with tilt/telescopic adjustment plus steering-wheel-mounted controls (and even adjustable foot pedals), it’s simple to dial in a position that feels tailored to you. Dual-zone climate controls keep peace between driver and front passenger, while a trip computer, tachometer, and cruise control help make longer drives feel effortless.On the road, it’s composed and confident. ABS brakes and electronic brake assistance work together for reassuring stops, while traction control and a vehicle stability control system help keep things planted. Add in the grip-focused hardware of a limited slip differential and locking differential, and you get a sedan that feels sure-footed when the road gets interesting. For parking and tight spots, an electronic parking aid lends a helping hand.Safety is built into the experience, with protective coverage from driver and passenger airbags, front side airbags, head protection, and side head curtain airbags, plus practical touches like child safety door locks and a vehicle anti-theft system. Automatic headlights and daytime running lights keep you visible, while heated exterior mirrors and an electrochromic rearview mirror help you stay focused when glare or weather tries to interfere.You’ll also appreciate the everyday practicality—power windows, a tire pressure monitor, run-flat tires, and even a full-size spare tire. And for the soundtrack, an AM/FM radio paired with a subwoofer adds depth to every drive.Best of all, a CARFAX report is available for this BMW, so you can shop with extra confidence. IT’S A HYBRID, BABY.

Porsche Marin is proud to present this exceptionally equipped 2019 Mercedes-Benz AMG E 53 4MATIC+ Sedan, a luxury performance sedan that seamlessly blends sophisticated styling, advanced technology, and exhilarating AMG performance. Finished in stunning Hyacinth Red over a Sahara Beige and Black premium leather interior, this AMG E 53 offers a rare and highly elegant specification complemented by an extensive list of premium factory options.
Powered by a turbocharged inline 6-cylinder engine paired with a 9-speed automatic transmission and Mercedes-Benz 4MATIC+ all-wheel-drive system, the AMG E 53 delivers impressive acceleration, refined handling, and confident performance in all driving conditions. AMG-tuned adaptive suspension with Air Body Control further enhances both ride comfort and dynamic capability, creating a driving experience that is equally engaging and luxurious.
The exterior is beautifully configured with 20-inch AMG multi-spoke wheels featuring grey accents, the Exterior Lighting Package, panorama roof, and AMG Performance Exhaust System, giving the vehicle a bold and unmistakably athletic presence. Soft Close Doors and illuminated AMG door sills add an additional touch of refinement and exclusivity.
Inside, the cabin showcases premium craftsmanship throughout with AMG Nappa leather upholstery in Macchiato Beige and Black, designo Black Piano Lacquer wood trim, and a black headliner that creates a sophisticated and performance-focused atmosphere. Heated and ventilated front seats, a heated steering wheel, 3-zone climate control, and the Air Balance cabin fragrance and filtration system ensure exceptional comfort for every occupant.
Technology and driver assistance features are seamlessly integrated throughout the vehicle, including the Driver Assistance Package, Parking Assistance Package, Head-Up Display with AMG-specific content, AMG Track Pace App, wireless charging capability, and advanced infotainment features designed to enhance both convenience and driver engagement.
Additional luxury features such as a panoramic roof, power-adjustable seating, adaptive ambient technologies, and premium audio integration further elevate the driving experience while maintaining the everyday usability expected from a Mercedes-Benz executive sedan.
With its powerful AMG performance, luxurious interior appointments, advanced technology, and striking color combination, this 2019 Mercedes-Benz AMG E 53 4MATIC+ Sedan represents an exceptional opportunity to own one of the most refined and versatile luxury performance sedans in its class.
For more information or to schedule a private viewing, please contact lcouncil@porschemarin.com or visit us in person.
